### Highlights | 更新内容

- 重构 SwiftUI 设置界面，重新组织串流、显示、音频、键鼠、手柄和更新页面；设置搜索支持具体选项，并补充中英文本地化。
  Reorganized the SwiftUI settings interface, added option-level search, and expanded Chinese and English localization.
- 改善局域网发现、地址管理和主机在线判断。首选地址不可用时继续检测其他地址，并在串流前提供切换提示。
  Improved LAN discovery, address management, and online detection when the preferred connection route is unavailable.
- 改善串流启动与原生解码处理，加入窗口内加载动画，修正 Metal 启动时的回调配置错误。
  Improved stream startup and native decoding, added an in-window loading indicator, and corrected Metal startup callback configuration.
- 修正单独 Command 键映射 Windows 键的处理，改善修饰键释放与自由鼠标窗口焦点行为。
  Fixed standalone Command-to-Windows-key handling and improved modifier release and Free Mouse window focus behavior.
- 完善 DualSense 类型识别、电量、动作、震动和灯光反馈；增加触控板透传与 Mac 风格模式，支持长按 Options 切换。
  Expanded DualSense mapping and feedback, with host touchpad and Mac-style pointer modes switchable by holding Options.
- 调整 DualSense 触控板轻点、自然滚动、滚动轴锁定和松手处理，减少光标跳动。
  Refined DualSense touchpad tapping, natural scrolling, axis locking, and release handling.
- 新增 10-bit SDR 协商，改善 HDR 色彩与画面比例处理，按所选渲染器显示适用设置。
  Added 10-bit SDR negotiation and refined HDR color and aspect-ratio handling, with renderer-specific settings.
- 增加 Foundation 显示器和虚拟显示器配置，改善文本及图片剪贴板协议兼容性。
  Added Foundation display and virtual-display configuration and improved text/image clipboard compatibility.
- 增加性能诊断和报告导出，提供帧率、1% low、网络及帧呈现抖动、丢帧和音频欠载数据。
  Added performance diagnostics and report export for frame rates, 1% low, jitter, dropped frames, and audio underruns.
- 接入 Sparkle 更新界面与测试版渠道。更新优先使用 GitHub，下载失败时尝试同版本的 CNB 镜像，并继续验证更新包签名。
  Integrated Sparkle updates and a beta channel, preferring GitHub and retrying the identical signed archive through CNB after download failure.
- 修正自定义分辨率输入及码率设置范围，使用独立应用身份以支持与 QT 版本共存。
  Corrected custom resolution and bitrate controls and isolated the app identity for coexistence with QT clients.

### Release Candidate | 候选版本说明

- 这是预发布版本。DualSense 新手势、Windows 设置自动滚动和 Metal HDR 显示效果仍需更多设备反馈。
  This is a prerelease. Further device testing is needed for the updated DualSense gestures, unexpected Windows Settings navigation, and Metal HDR presentation.
- Dolby Vision 8.1/8.4 与 HDR10+ 已有能力探测和适配代码，尚未验证完整动态元数据输出；HDR Vivid 当前不可用。
  Dolby Vision 8.1/8.4 and HDR10+ integration is not yet verified end to end. HDR Vivid is unavailable.
- USB 转发和主机文件为实验性能力，需要支持并启用对应功能的 Foundation Sunshine。真实 USB 设备转发与 Finder 文件挂载尚未完成验收；Finder 挂载还依赖可用的签名及 App Group 配置。
  USB forwarding and Host Files are experimental and require the corresponding Foundation Sunshine features. Physical USB forwarding and Finder mounting remain unverified; Finder integration also requires a suitable signed App Group configuration.
